table_description: The BRANCH table stores information about different branches, with a composite primary key consisting of branch_id, region_code, subregion_code, and office_code. It provides details about the geographical and organizational structure of the branches.

columns.name: branch_id
columns.description: The branch_id column uniquely identifies records in the table as part of the composite primary key, likely representing a unique identifier for each branch.

columns.name: gsscore_servicebranchnumber
columns.description: The gsscore_servicebranchnumber column stores a string value that may represent a service branch number, although its exact purpose is ambiguous without further context.

columns.name: region_code
columns.description: The region_code column is part of the composite primary key and likely represents a code for the region where the branch is located, uniquely identifying records in the table.

columns.name: region
columns.description: The region column stores a string value representing the name of the region where the branch is located, serving an analytical purpose of providing geographical context.

columns.name: subregion_code
columns.description: The subregion_code column is part of the composite primary key and likely represents a code for the subregion within the region where the branch is located, uniquely identifying records in the table.

columns.name: subregion
columns.description: The subregion column stores a string value representing the name of the subregion within the region where the branch is located, serving an analytical purpose of providing more detailed geographical context.

columns.name: gbo
columns.description: The gbo column stores a string value, but its purpose is ambiguous without further context, potentially representing some form of organizational or geographical identifier.

columns.name: office_code
columns.description: The office_code column is part of the composite primary key and likely represents a unique identifier for the office within the branch, uniquely identifying records in the table.

columns.name: office_name
columns.description: The office_name column stores a string value representing the name of the office within the branch, serving an analytical purpose of providing context about the organizational structure of the branch.
